The art department cleaned the car park as well as it could be cleaned, and painted the seven on the ground. In post we still spent hours taking stains out of the asphalt.

The cars were a job of their own. From up there you see every car at once, so red, grey and black had to be parked in exactly the right spots.

Thanks to Hartgerink en Klomp @hartgerinkenklomp for the location.

Comment 'MAGI' and I'll send you the step by step.

Same 3D blockout from moviepr3p.com, same sheets, same prompt. One shot in MAGI-2 at 1080p, one in Seedance 2.5 at 1080p. MAGI-2 follows the camera move just as well and costs $0.80 for 10 seconds. Seedance costs $11.40 for the same 10 seconds.

The 3D sketch is where you fix the camera, so the expensive part only has to happen once.

Comment 'GUIDE' and I'll send you the step by step.

The shot: a probe lens skims along the book spines of a library aisle, turns hard right and flies through the gap where one book is missing. On the other side a guy sits on the floor reading exactly that book, and he is not impressed. I built that route in 3D in moviepr3p.com first. That costs money too, but a lot less than a Seedance generation, so the camera move gets sorted there and not in the expensive part.

Then the MP4 goes into Claude with three Higgsfield sheets: the reader, the library, the book. The 480p draft takes the same route through the same gap. One draft, same sweater, same red book.
